landing.heroTitle: AI answers the call, pros show up
landing.heroSubtitle: A LINE AI agent takes repair requests 24/7 — understanding text and photos; smart dispatch matches local locksmiths; quoting, on-site work, dual-signature closing and reconciliation, all in one place.

landing.f3Desc: Accept jobs, navigate, report arrival by GPS, take before/after photos and close with dual signatures — earnings at a glance.
landing.f4Desc: Send quotes to customers via LINE for one-tap approval; invoices, reconciliation and monthly statements are wired together.

landing.s2Desc: Back-office assignment or job-pool claiming, with instant notifications
